heading: The Challenge
bodyColumns: Pension funds, sovereign wealth vehicles, and climate mandated asset managers need auditable proof of the energy behind Bitcoin before they can hold it.
Mining's energy disclosures today are fragmented, self-reported, and largely unverifiable. That verification gap keeps trillions on the sidelines.

quote.text: "We don't advocate for any single energy source. We verify and attest."
